verses.original: וּבֹ֨עַז עָלָ֣ה הַשַּׁעַר֮ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁם֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַגֹּאֵ֤ל בֹּ֔עַז דִּבֶּר־ עֹבֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר וַיֹּ֛אמֶר ס֥וּרָה פֹּ֖ה פְּלֹנִ֣י אַלְמֹנִ֑י שְׁבָה־ וַיָּ֖סַר וַיֵּשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇō·‘az ‘ā·lāh haš·ša·‘ar way·yê·šeḇ šām wə·hin·nêh hag·gō·’êl bō·‘az dib·ber- ‘ō·ḇêr ’ă·šer way·yō·mer sū·rāh pōh pə·lō·nî ’al·mō·nî šə·ḇāh- way·yā·sar way·yê·šêḇ
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom [he] had spoken came along - and Boaz said Come over here my friend . . . and sit down So he went over and sat down

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁבוּ־ פֹ֑ה וַיֵּשֵֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ‘ă·śā·rāh ’ă·nā·šîm miz·ziq·nê hā·‘îr way·yō·mer šə·ḇū- p̄ōh way·yê·šê·ḇū
verses.literal: Then Boaz took ten . . . of the elders of the city and said Sit here and they did so

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַגֹּאֵ֔ל נָעֳמִ֔י הַשָּׁ֖בָה מִשְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב׃ מָכְרָ֣ה חֶלְקַת֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאָחִ֖ינוּ לֶאֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lag·gō·’êl nā·‘o·mî haš·šā·ḇāh miś·śə·ḏêh mō·w·’āḇ mā·ḵə·rāh ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer lə·’ā·ḥî·nū le·’ĕ·lî·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And he said to the kinsman-redeemer Naomi who has returned from the land of Moab is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֶגְלֶ֧ה אָזְנְךָ֣ לֵאמֹ֗ר קְ֠נֵה נֶ֥גֶד הַֽיֹּשְׁבִים֮ וְנֶ֣גֶד זִקְנֵ֣י עַמִּי֒ אִם־ תִּגְאַל֙ גְּאָ֔ל וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יִגְאַ֜ל הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י וְאֵדַע כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין זוּלָֽתְךָ֙ לִגְא֔וֹל וְאָנֹכִ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ אָנֹכִ֥י אֶגְאָֽל׃ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’eḡ·leh ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā lê·mōr qə·nêh ne·ḡeḏ hay·yō·šə·ḇîm wə·ne·ḡeḏ ziq·nê ‘am·mî ’im- tiḡ·’al gə·’āl wə·’im- lō yiḡ·’al hag·gî·ḏāh lî wə·ʾē·ḏaʿ kî ’ên zū·lā·ṯə·ḵā liḡ·’ō·wl wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eḡ·’āl way·yō·mer
verses.literal: I thought I should inform you that you may buy it back in the presence of those seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people If you want to redeem it do so But if you will not redeem [it] tell me so I may know because [there is] no one but you to redeem [it] and I [am] next after you I will redeem [it] he replied

verses.original: בֹּ֔עַז וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בְּיוֹם־ קְנוֹתְךָ֥ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד נָעֳמִ֑י וּ֠מֵאֵת ר֣וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה קָנִיתִי אֵֽשֶׁת־ הַמֵּת֙ לְהָקִ֥ים שֵׁם־ הַמֵּ֖ת עַל־ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·‘az way·yō·mer bə·yō·wm- qə·nō·wṯ·ḵā haś·śā·ḏeh mî·yaḏ nā·‘o·mî ū·mê·’êṯ rūṯ ham·mō·w·’ă·ḇî·yāh qå̄·nī·ṯī ’ê·šeṯ- ham·mêṯ lə·hā·qîm šêm- ham·mêṯ ‘al- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then Boaz said On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance

verses.original: הַגֹּאֵ֗ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לִגְאוֹל לִ֔י פֶּן־ אַשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־ נַחֲלָתִ֑י גְּאֻלָּתִ֔י גְּאַל־ לְךָ֤ אַתָּה֙ אֶת־ כִּ֥י לֹא־ אוּכַ֖ל לִגְאֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·’êl way·yō·mer lō ’ū·ḵal liḡ·ʾōl pen- ’aš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯî gə·’ul·lā·ṯî gə·’al- lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ’eṯ- kî lō- ’ū·ḵal liḡ·’ōl
verses.literal: The kinsman-redeemer replied I cannot . . . redeem it myself or I would jeopardize - my own inheritance Take my right of redemption . . . . . . . . . - because I cannot . . . redeem it

verses.original: וְזֹאת֩ לְפָנִ֨ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עַל־ הַגְּאוּלָּ֤ה וְעַל־ הַתְּמוּרָה֙ כָּל־ דָּבָ֔ר לְקַיֵּ֣ם אִ֛ישׁ שָׁלַ֥ף נַעֲל֖וֹ וְנָתַ֣ן לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ וְזֹ֥את הַתְּעוּדָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ lə·p̄ā·nîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- hag·gə·’ūl·lāh wə·‘al- hat·tə·mū·rāh kāl- dā·ḇār lə·qay·yêm ’îš šā·lap̄ na·‘ă·lōw wə·nā·ṯan lə·rê·‘ê·hū wə·zōṯ hat·tə·‘ū·ḏāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now in former times in Israel concerning the redemption . . . or exchange of property to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party and this [was] a confirmation in Israel

verses.original: הַגֹּאֵ֛ל וַיִּשְׁלֹ֖ף נַעֲלֽוֹ׃ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר לְבֹ֖עַז קְנֵה־ לָ֑ךְ
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·’êl way·yiš·lōp̄ na·‘ă·lōw way·yō·mer lə·ḇō·‘az qə·nêh- lāḵ
verses.literal: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz Buy [it] for yourself

verses.original: בֹּ֨עַז וַיֹּאמֶר֩ לַזְּקֵנִ֜ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֗ם אַתֶּם֙ עֵדִ֤ים הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֤י קָנִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ מִיַּ֖ד נָעֳמִֽי׃ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֶֽאֱלִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְכִלְי֖וֹן וּמַחְל֑וֹן
verses.transliteration: bō·‘az way·yō·mer laz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’at·tem ‘ê·ḏîm hay·yō·wm kî qā·nî·ṯî ’eṯ- mî·yaḏ nā·‘o·mî kāl- ’ă·šer le·’ĕ·lî·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lə·ḵil·yō·wn ū·maḥ·lō·wn
verses.literal: At this, Boaz said to the elders and all the people You are witnesses today that I am buying - from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech - - - Chilion and Mahlon

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ קָנִ֧יתִי לִ֣י ר֣וּת הַמֹּאֲבִיָּה֩ מַחְל֜וֹן אֵ֨שֶׁת לְאִשָּׁ֗ה לְהָקִ֤ים שֵׁם־ הַמֵּת֙ עַל־ נַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ הַמֵּ֛ת שֵׁם־ וְלֹא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת מֵעִ֥ם אֶחָ֖יו וּמִשַּׁ֣עַר מְקוֹמ֑וֹ אַתֶּ֖ם עֵדִ֥ים הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- qā·nî·ṯî lî rūṯ ham·mō·’ă·ḇî·yāh maḥ·lō·wn ’ê·šeṯ lə·’iš·šāh lə·hā·qîm šêm- ham·mêṯ ‘al- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ham·mêṯ šêm- wə·lō- yik·kā·rêṯ mê·‘im ’e·ḥāw ū·miš·ša·‘ar mə·qō·w·mōw ’at·tem ‘ê·ḏîm hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Moreover - I have acquired . . . Ruth the Moabitess Mahlon’s widow as my wife to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home You are witnesses today . . .

verses.original: עֵדִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֖ים כָּל־ הָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּשַּׁ֛עַר יְהוָ֨ה אֶֽת־ יִתֵּן֩ הָאִשָּׁ֜ה הַבָּאָ֣ה אֶל־ בֵּיתֶ֗ךָ כְּרָחֵ֤ל׀ וּכְלֵאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנ֤וּ שְׁתֵּיהֶם֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַעֲשֵׂה־ חַ֣יִל בְּאֶפְרָ֔תָה וּקְרָא־ שֵׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ḏîm way·yō·mə·rū wə·haz·zə·qê·nîm kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- baš·ša·‘ar Yah·weh ’eṯ- yit·tên hā·’iš·šāh hab·bā·’āh ’el- bê·ṯe·ḵā kə·rā·ḥêl ū·ḵə·lê·’āh ’ă·šer bā·nū šə·tê·hem ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wa·‘ă·śêh- ḥa·yil bə·’ep̄·rā·ṯāh ū·qə·rā- šêm bə·ḇêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: We are witnesses said the elders and all the people - at the gate May the LORD - make the woman entering . . . your home like Rachel and Leah who together built up . . . - the house of Israel May you be prosperous in Ephrathah and famous . . . vvv in Bethlehem

verses.original: בֵֽיתְךָ֙ וִיהִ֤י כְּבֵ֣ית פֶּ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ תָמָ֖ר יָלְדָ֥ה לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה מִן־ הַזֶּ֗רַע אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ יִתֵּ֤ן לְךָ֔ מִן־ הַזֹּֽאת׃ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ḇê·ṯə·ḵā wî·hî kə·ḇêṯ pe·reṣ ’ă·šer- ṯā·mār yā·lə·ḏāh lî·hū·ḏāh min- haz·ze·ra‘ ’ă·šer Yah·weh yit·tên lə·ḵā min- haz·zōṯ han·na·‘ă·rāh
verses.literal: And may your house become like the house of Perez whom Tamar bore to Judah because of the offspring - the LORD will give you by this young woman

verses.original: בֹּ֤עַז אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֨ח רוּת֙ וַתְּהִי־ ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶ֑יהָ יְהוָ֥ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָ֛הּ הֵרָי֖וֹן וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bō·‘az ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ rūṯ wat·tə·hî- lōw lə·’iš·šāh way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā Yah·weh way·yit·tên lāh hê·rā·yō·wn wat·tê·leḏ bên
verses.literal: So Boaz - took Ruth and she became his wife And when he had relations with her the LORD enabled her to conceive and she gave birth to a son

verses.original: הַנָּשִׁים֙ וַתֹּאמַ֤רְנָה אֶֽל־ נָעֳמִ֔י בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א הִשְׁבִּ֥ית לָ֛ךְ הַיּ֑וֹם גֹּאֵ֖ל שְׁמ֖וֹ וְיִקָּרֵ֥א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·šîm wat·tō·mar·nāh ’el- nā·‘o·mî bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō hiš·bîṯ lāḵ hay·yō·wm gō·’êl šə·mōw wə·yiq·qā·rê bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the women said to Naomi Blessed [be] the LORD who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer May his name become famous in Israel

verses.original: וְהָ֤יָה לְמֵשִׁ֣יב לָךְ֙ נֶ֔פֶשׁ וּלְכַלְכֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׂיבָתֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י כַלָּתֵ֤ךְ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ אֲהֵבַ֙תֶךְ֙ ט֣וֹבָה לָ֔ךְ מִשִּׁבְעָ֖ה בָּנִֽים׃ יְלָדַ֔תּוּ אֲשֶׁר־ הִיא֙
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·mê·šîḇ lāḵ ne·p̄eš ū·lə·ḵal·kêl ’eṯ- śê·ḇā·ṯêḵ kî ḵal·lā·ṯêḵ ’ăšer- ’ă·hê·ḇa·ṯeḵ ṭō·w·ḇāh lāḵ miš·šiḇ·‘āh bā·nîm yə·lā·ḏat·tū ’ă·šer- hî
verses.literal: He will renew . . . your life and sustain you - in your old age For your daughter-in-law who loves you and is better to you than seven sons has given him birth - -

verses.original: נָעֳמִ֤י אֶת־ וַתִּקַּ֨ח הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ וַתְּשִׁתֵ֣הוּ בְחֵיקָ֔הּ וַתְּהִי־ לְאֹמֶֽנֶת׃ ל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: nā·‘o·mî ’eṯ- wat·tiq·qaḥ hay·ye·leḏ wat·tə·ši·ṯê·hū ḇə·ḥê·qāh wat·tə·hî- lə·’ō·me·neṯ lōw
verses.literal: And Naomi - took the child placed him on her lap and became a nurse to him

verses.original: הַשְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת לֵאמֹ֔ר בֵּ֖ן יֻלַּד־ לְנָעֳמִ֑י וַתִּקְרֶ֤אנָֽה שְׁמוֹ֙ וַתִּקְרֶאנָה֩ ל֨וֹ שֵׁם֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד ה֥וּא אֲבִי־ יִשַׁ֖י אֲבִ֥י דָוִֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḵê·nō·wṯ lê·mōr bên yul·laḏ- lə·nā·‘o·mî wat·tiq·re·nāh šə·mōw wat·tiq·re·nāh lōw šêm ‘ō·w·ḇêḏ hū ’ă·ḇî- yi·šay ’ă·ḇî ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: The neighbor women said A son has been born to Naomi . . . . . . and they named him - Obed He [became] the father of Jesse the father of David

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְד֣וֹת פָּ֔רֶץ פֶּ֖רֶץ הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ חֶצְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏō·wṯ pā·reṣ pe·reṣ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ḥeṣ·rō·wn
verses.literal: Now these [are] the generations of Perez Perez was the father of - Hezron

verses.original: וְחֶצְרוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ רָ֔ם וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עַמִּֽינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥeṣ·rō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- rām wə·rām hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: Hezron was the father of - Ram Ram was the father of - Amminadab

verses.original: וְעַמִּֽינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ נַחְשׁ֔וֹן וְנַחְשׁ֖וֹן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ שַׂלְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- naḥ·šō·wn wə·naḥ·šō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- śal·māh
verses.literal: Amminadab was the father of - Nahshon Nahshon was the father of - Salmon

verses.original: וְשַׂלְמוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בֹּ֔עַז וּבֹ֖עַז הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עוֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śal·mō·wn hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- bō·‘az ū·ḇō·‘az hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ō·w·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Salmon was the father of - Boaz Boaz was the father of - Obed

verses.original: וְעֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יִשָׁ֔י וְיִשַׁ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·ḇêḏ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yi·šāy wə·yi·šay hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Obed was the father of - Jesse and Jesse was the father of - David
